etymology: Pictograph: the mirror image of 司 'director' — the sovereign consort: empress; also 'after' in 午後's ancestor.
mnemonic: 司 reflected: command from the other throne — コウ. 皇后: the empress beside the emperor.

etymology: Compound ideograph: the child (子) carrying the elder (耂) — the young supporting the old: filial piety.
mnemonic: The child shoulders the grandparent — コウ. 親孝行: paying the oldest debt.

etymology: Compound: radiance (白) over the king (王) — the king with the shining crown: emperor.
mnemonic: A king, backlit — コウ. 天皇: the shining above the crown above the land.

etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 岡 'ridge' (phonetic コウ) — metal hard as the ridge line: steel.
mnemonic: Iron that did strength training — はがね. 鉄鋼: industry's spine.

etymology: Phono-semantic: husk (殻) + grain (禾) — grains in their husks: cereals.
mnemonic: Everything that comes armored in a husk — コク. 穀物: the pantry's foundation.

etymology: Phono-semantic: cutting (𢦏, phonetic サイ) + cloth (衣) — cutting cloth to measure: to tailor; cutting cases to measure: to judge.
mnemonic: Scissors through fabric, gavel through disputes — さばく. 裁判所: the tailor shop for arguments.

etymology: Phono-semantic: bamboo (⺮) + 朿 (phonetic サク) — the bamboo slips of counsel: a plan, a policy; originally also the riding crop.
mnemonic: Plans written on slips, with a spur inside — サク. 対策: the counter-scheme.

etymology: Compound (simplified from 蠶): the insect (虫) sent from heaven (天) — the worm that spins wealth: silkworm.
mnemonic: Heaven's bug — かいこ. Its thread bought empires: 蚕 over 糸.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 次 (phonetic シ) + woman (女) — the shape one presents: figure, appearance.
mnemonic: The silhouette before the name registers — すがた. 後ろ姿: the figure walking away.

etymology: Pictograph: an arrow arrived at the ground — reaching the very point: to arrive; the utmost (至急).
mnemonic: The arrow can go no further — いたる. 冬至: the sun's arrival at its southern limit.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 示 (phonetic シ) + 見 'see' — looking with intent: to view, regard.
mnemonic: Seeing, upgraded to watching — シ. 無視: aiming the gaze away on purpose.

etymology: Phono-semantic: stone (石) + 茲 (phonetic ジ) — the stone that draws: magnet; the fine fired stone: porcelain.
mnemonic: The rock with invisible threads (茲) pulling — ジ. 磁石: the pointing stone.

etymology: Compound ideograph: the body (身) drawn and the hand (寸) releasing — loosing the arrow: to shoot, emit.
mnemonic: Whole body behind the release — シャ. 注射: the clinical arrow; 反射: light shooting back.

etymology: Pictograph: a hand spanning a length — the shaku, the old Japanese foot (~30cm): measure.
mnemonic: Thumb to little finger: the carpenter's ruler before rulers — シャク. 尺八: the flute, one-shaku-eight.

etymology: Phono-semantic: tree (木) + a phonetic (ジュ) — the standing living tree, planted and kept: timber.
mnemonic: 木's ceremonial full name — ジュ. 樹木, 街路樹: trees with paperwork.

etymology: Compound ideograph: the altar (示) under the roof (宀) — the ancestral shrine: the founding line: sect, religion.
mnemonic: The altar the whole clan shares — シュウ. 宗教: the roofed altar, systematized.

etymology: Compound: moving to the capital's high ground (京) — taking one's place: to take up (a post), to settle.
mnemonic: Arriving where your career lives — シュウ. 就職: settling into the harness.

etymology: Compound ideograph: many people (three 人) under the sun/eye — the multitude: the masses.
mnemonic: Three means everyone — シュウ. 衆議院: the house of the many.

etymology: Compound (simplified from 從): one person walking behind another (从) on the road (彳) — to follow, comply.
mnemonic: Footsteps matched to footsteps — したがう. 従業員: those who walk the company's pace.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 従 (phonetic ジュウ) — the warp thread running lengthwise: vertical.
mnemonic: The thread that follows gravity — たて. 縦書き: Japanese, written the tall way.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 宿 (phonetic シュク) — cloth drawn in on itself: to shrink, contract.
mnemonic: The sweater that came back from the wash a size smaller — ちぢむ. 短縮: schedules doing the same.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 孰 (phonetic ジュク) + fire (灬) — cooked through: ripe, matured, practiced.
mnemonic: Slow heat until fully done — ジュク. 熟語: word-pairs aged together; 塾: the cram school homophone next door.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + a phonetic (ショウ) — the hurt carried on a person: wound, damage.
mnemonic: The mark the story leaves — きず. 傷つく: hearts and knees alike.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + 章 (phonetic ショウ) — the wall in the way: to obstruct.
mnemonic: A rampart where the road wanted to be — さわる. 故障: the machine's private rampart.

etymology: Compound ideograph: person (亻) + two (二) — what passes between two people: benevolence, the Confucian heart.
mnemonic: Kindness needs a minimum of two — ジン. 仁: ethics in three strokes.

etymology: Pictograph: branches heavy to the ground — hanging down: to droop, dangle.
mnemonic: The willow's posture — たれる. 垂直: hanging true — the plumb line's kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 隹 (phonetic スイ) — pushing forward: to推 recommend; pushing thought forward: to infer.
mnemonic: Give the idea a shove and see where it rolls — おす. 推理: detective work; 推し: your favorite, shoved at everyone.

etymology: Ideograph: a hand with a dot at the pulse — one thumb-width below the wrist: the sun (~3cm): small measure.
mnemonic: The doctor's finger finding the pulse: precision — スン. 寸法: measurements, tailor-grade.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 成 (phonetic セイ) + dish (皿) — the dish piled to completion: heaped, flourishing.
mnemonic: Rice mounded past the rim — もる, さかん. 大盛り: prosperity, per bowl.

etymology: Compound: the one whose ear (耳) hears heaven and whose mouth (口) speaks it — the sage: holy.
mnemonic: Ears open upward, words passed down — セイ. 聖書: the transcript.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 成 (phonetic セイ) — words that become deeds: sincerity.
mnemonic: Say it, then be it — まこと. 誠実: the audit both passed.

etymology: Pictograph: the tongue extended from the mouth (口).
mnemonic: Stuck out for the doctor — した. 舌 does the tasting in 味's world.

etymology: Compound: the ruler's word spreading (亘) from under the palace roof (宀) — to proclaim.
mnemonic: Announced from the palace steps — セン. 宣伝: proclamation with a budget.

etymology: Compound ideograph: cloth dipped in tree-sap water nine (九) times — steeped: to dye, to seep in.
mnemonic: Nine baths in the vat until the color stays — そめる. 感染: the unwanted kind of soaking-in.

etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 戔 'pared small' (phonetic セン) — metal cut small: coins, small change.
mnemonic: Metal shaved into pocket money — ぜに. 銭湯: a coin, a bath, a century of custom.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 倉 (phonetic ソウ) + blade (刂) — the first cut into new material: to originate, found; also a wound.
mnemonic: Creation starts with an incision — ソウ. 創造: the blade's noble career.

etymology: Compound: both hands offering up to heaven — presenting before the throne: to perform, play music.
mnemonic: Music lifted upward like an offering — かなでる. 演奏: the concert kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 延 (phonetic タン) — originally 'extravagant talk'; settled on the grandest announcement: a birth.
mnemonic: The announcement worth exaggerating — タン. 誕生日: the yearly re-proclamation.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 中 'center' (phonetic チュウ) + heart (心) — the heart held dead center: loyalty.
mnemonic: A heart that doesn't wobble — チュウ. 忠犬ハチ公: the statue of this kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 朝 (phonetic チョウ) — the morning water that comes and goes: the tide.
mnemonic: The sea's commute — しお. 風潮: the tide, applied to opinions.

etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 昜 (phonetic チョウ) — the long coiled organ: intestines.
mnemonic: The body's longest corridor — チョウ. 大腸・小腸: the plumbing diagram.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 啇 (phonetic テキ) + 攵 'strike' — the one you trade blows with: enemy, rival.
mnemonic: Whoever the stick is pointed at — かたき. 素敵, oddly: 'enemy-class' good — stunning.

etymology: Phono-semantic: rice (米) + 唐 (phonetic トウ) — sweetness refined from grain, via Tang China: sugar.
mnemonic: Rice's sweetest descendant — トウ. 砂糖: sand-sugar, the pantry pair.

etymology: Compound: words (言) + hand (寸) — the punitive expedition declared and executed: to attack; to examine (検討).
mnemonic: First the proclamation, then the strike — うつ. 検討します: the boardroom's polite siege.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 内 (phonetic ノウ) — brought inside and stored: to deliver, pay in, accept.
mnemonic: The tribute tucked into the storehouse — おさめる. 納豆: beans put away — fermented history.

etymology: Compound: water (氵) branching (𠂢) — a stream split from the main: a faction; to send off a branch: dispatch.
mnemonic: The river splits and each branch names itself — ハ. 派手: the loudest branch.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 非 (phonetic ハイ) — the performer of light verse and play: actor; the verse: haiku.
mnemonic: A person balancing on 非's two wings — ハイ. 俳句 and 俳優: seventeen syllables, or a whole career.

etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 市 (phonetic ハイ) — the paired breathing organs: lungs.
mnemonic: The chest's twin markets, trading air — ハイ. 肺活量: their turnover.
